planSteps.description: Open RoomTrace at the test target URL and enter the labeled sample journal.
Start a new observation, choose Move-out, and select Kitchen.
Choose the existing Kitchen move-in record titled Sink cabinet · arrival as the exact baseline.
Enter a unique move-out title and note.
Fetch the public synthetic /test-fixtures/departure.png bytes and attach them through the Original photos input.
Open Compare and select the newly created Kitchen pair.
Assert that Compare shows the exact move-in baseline, move-out title, and both photo records.
